g.text: Both branch views include the same prefix
The reused 86 initial evaluations are not new work.
Audit replay: 1,080 materialized records, including clones.
All 8 branches complete; no missing/failed branch.
Both workers’ second actions changed in all 4 pairs.

g.text: Two-worker peer-observation cohort: cost and allocation

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #25313c

g.text: Open blue: private own history. Filled orange: own + peer first action/feedback. All four paired costs and best identities tied.
Two exposed tasks × 2 repeat/order IDs; unmatched second-decision model randomness. Same actual first work cloned into both branches.
Duplicates and overlap are schedule-based counts, not independent discoveries; fewer duplicates can accompany less realized work. Tiny descriptive sharing pilot, not full Apex autonomy.
